text:
Noah: Heads-up 1  playground streaming small-UX review. Quick: users confuse small streamed fragments for progress; they want clearer controls and token visibility.
Zara: Quick sketch idea: collapse trailing fragments into a single compact "stream paused" pill with token count and a chevron to expand.
Felix: For a11y we can't keep announcing every fragment. Keep aria-live=polite for chunks, announce pill once on pause: 'Stream paused, 17 tokens buffered'. Make pill tabbable.
Mina: Controls: 3 choices inline micro-actions, right-side floating toolbar, or message overflow menu. I'm leaning floating toolbar for long outputs and inline for <120 chars.
Noah: Microcopy for pill: "Streaming paused 17 tokens buffered" vs "Output paused 17 queued". Which feels clearer?
Zara: "Streaming paused" is explicit that it's live. Include aria-label: "Streaming paused, 17 tokens buffered. Actions: resume, stop, copy."
Felix: Token counter: show tiny "17 tks" by timestamp; tooltip 'Token usage for this response' and a pin toggle to keep it visible for that conversation. Tooltips must appear on focus.
Mina: Regen verbs: If runtime supports continue-from-buffer show 'Resume', otherwise 'Regenerate'. Also show keyboard hint: 'Regenerate (Ctrl/Cmd+Enter)'.
Noah: Telemetry: playground.stream_pause, playground.resume_click, playground.regenerate_click. Payload: buffered_tokens, source (network|user|runtime).
ops-bot: Deploy note: demo branch created: playground/stream-pill-controls  preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/playground/stream-pill-controls
Zara: UX test idea: A/B test pill vs inline actions for confusion metrics. Also test pinning token display vs hover-only.
Felix: Dev note: runtime already exposes buffered_count and est_remaining. We should be conservative showing percent. Show "~65%" only when estimate_confidence > 0.7.
Mina: I'll prototype in Figma and link. Will also add keyboard flow for SR.
Noah: Great  thanks team. Ping when prototype ready for PM review.
